correctness.rationale: Each omitted k-set has all Johnson-graph neighbors allowed. Thus the deterministic loss of maximizing a score vector is exactly the kth adjacent order-statistic gap if, and only if, its top-k label set is omitted. Reversing the scores gives the bottom-k loss. The sorted Gaussian values and their centered norm are independent of label permutations; the top/bottom k-set pair is uniform over ordered pairs whose intersection equals max(0,2k-n), with N*L outcomes. Expanding the square of the two losses leaves an m-dependent term plus 2*gamma*C/(N*L), while linear and mixed terms depend on m alone. Positive spacings give gamma>0. Both explicit six-element families have two excluded triples, C=2 versus C=0, and the resulting gap is E[S^2]/5. Rank-three Ehrhart equality follows from Ferroni–Schroeter Proposition 7.12, with five finite dilate checks as corroboration. Independent exhaustive finite checks cover 13,800 strict-score support comparisons; those do not substitute for the symbolic all-ranks proof.

value.rationale: Ehrhart- and mean-width-indistinguishable matroid polytopes need not be indistinguishable by random Euclidean directions. The exact all-rank formula isolates the first nonlinear correction as a natural forbidden-circuit pair-incidence statistic, with an explicit rank-three six-point witness where that statistic changes from 0 to 2. This supplies a transparent boundary to established valuative equivalence and motivates directional geometry beyond Ehrhart/volume counts; the result is a structural identity, not a routine special-case enumeration.
